criteria: AC4 — a fresh second checkout resumes through explicit attributed operator trust with no private-store handoff. After one manual criterion and atomic receipt are committed, a fresh second checkout with an empty or nonexistent Taskplane home and no first-checkout access invokes pickup with --trust-source <exact-source-sha>. The exact flag and full SHA are recorded verbatim in the new receipt as attributed human authority; the SHA equals the shelf authorized source SHA and existing exact-SHA, Design-fingerprint, and receipt-lineage identity; the next existing BUILD-C checkpoint runs with zero run, track, claim, lease, wave, or private-handoff state; and no output claims cryptographic authenticity. The unchanged v1 private-secret symmetric path retains focused green coverage.

Completed T01 through T04, repository-only resume at 3ee3a17a695bf059f90504507a8eb5fe690fb52d, and retry-safe atomic receipt publication at a73f125e762670323d0e4a8fbbef3a1edf3ea958 are inventory only and must not be replayed, replaced, or assigned a new checkpoint or evaluation.

The only accepted trust option is exact `--trust-source`: all eleven proper prefixes (`--t`, `--tr`, `--tru`, `--trus`, `--trust`, `--trust-`, `--trust-s`, `--trust-so`, `--trust-sou`, `--trust-sour`, `--trust-sourc`) plus named alternate-case, underscore, omitted-hyphen, and suffix forms refuse before `cmd_pickup`, `pickup.run`, BUILD-C, receipt publication, or private-state creation.

Define one private `_OperatorTrust` standard-library dataclass with `frozen=True` and `slots=True`; `_parse_operator_trust(raw, *, boundary, expected_source_sha, required)` is the sole CLI-string and receipt-mapping construction factory, `_serialize_operator_trust` explicitly emits only the five closed persisted fields, and neither raw authority data nor `_OperatorTrust` crosses the unchanged micro-plan handoff to BUILD-C.

The v2 receipt records the exact verbatim `--trust-source` flag/value as attributed human authority with `cryptographic_authenticity_claimed: false`; public output, traces, tests, and receipt data must make no cryptographic-authenticity, signed-human, producer-origin, or repository-origin claim.

Operator mode appends only a strict additive `taskplane.pickup-receipt/v2` after a zero-or-more contiguous incumbent-v1 prefix; v1 after v2, malformed/unknown/missing operator fields, a true authenticity claim, mixed source or Design identity, and digest/path/predecessor/fork/gap/collision/mixed-lineage failures refuse before BUILD-C and leave every prior receipt byte-identical with no authoritative partial file.

The no-flag incumbent private-secret path remains byte- and behavior-compatible, invokes the unchanged v1 verifier/key source, writes the exact v1 receipt field set without `operator_trust`, and retains its existing focused green and tamper coverage.

Positive and negative operator-trust paths preserve the existing `assign_direct_scopes` → BUILD-C → checkpoint → merge-on-green path, one-criterion discipline, retry-safe atomic publication, and exactly zero run, track, claim, lease, wave, active-loop, private-handoff, or equivalent state.
